title: Florida sets record for sea turtle nests but Trump move could stall recovery

paragraphs.en: Wildlife groups in Florida are celebrating record numbers of sea turtle nests this season, but experts warn Donald Trump’s recent gutting of the Endangered Species Act (ESA) could reverse decades of their recovery from the edge of extinction.
paragraphs.zh: 佛罗里达州的野生动物保护组织正在庆祝本季海龟巢穴数量创下纪录，但专家警告说，唐纳德·特朗普最近对《濒危物种法》（ESA）的大幅削弱，可能逆转它们数十年来从灭绝边缘恢复的进程。

paragraphs.en: With more than two months of the summer nesting season still to run, loggerhead turtles have already made 13,770 nests , hundreds more than recorded in any previous year, along an 8.5-mile stretch of shoreline monitored by the Loggerhead Marinelife Center in Juno Beach, on Florida’s Atlantic coast.
paragraphs.zh: 夏季筑巢季还有两个多月才结束，在佛罗里达州大西洋沿岸朱诺海滩由“蠵龟海洋生物中心”监测的一段8.5英里长的海岸线上，蠵龟（loggerhead turtles）已经筑下13770个巢，比以往任何一年记录的巢穴数量都多出数百个。

paragraphs.en: The same record has fallen on Sanibel island, on the Gulf coast, where loggerheads have laid 922 nests so far this year, surpassing the 2023 total of 878, according to the Sanibel-Captiva Conservation Foundation.
paragraphs.zh: 据萨尼贝尔-卡普蒂瓦保护基金会称，墨西哥湾沿岸的萨尼贝尔岛也打破了纪录，今年到目前为止蠵龟已筑下922个巢，超过了2023年的878个。

paragraphs.en: The numbers reflect the ongoing revival of sea turtles since the 1970s, when overhunting, poaching and habitat loss pushed several species to the brink, including the loss of about 95% of the Caribbean’s population of green turtles.
paragraphs.zh: 这些数字反映出自20世纪70年代以来海龟的持续复兴。当时，过度捕猎、偷猎和栖息地丧失将多个物种推向灭绝边缘，其中包括加勒比海绿海龟种群损失了约95%。

paragraphs.en: The ESA, passed in 1973, enshrined protections that are paying dividends now because sea turtle hatchlings take years to decades to reach reproductive age. The loss of those safeguards, from Trump’s “death sentence” repeal last month of sections of the law to favor oil drilling, mining, logging and development interests, has some experts fearful that the recovery might have reached the high-water mark.
paragraphs.zh: 1973年通过的《濒危物种法》确立了保护措施，如今这些措施正在产生回报，因为海龟幼体需要数年至数十年才能达到繁殖年龄。特朗普上个月为偏袒石油钻探、采矿、伐木和开发利益而废除了该法部分条款，被形容为对海龟的“死刑判决”。保护措施的丧失让一些专家担忧，海龟的复苏可能已经到达高点。

paragraphs.en: An alliance of environmental and wildlife groups is suing the Trump administration in part over a rule giving outsized deference to “economic considerations” when determining protections for endangered species and critical habitat.
paragraphs.zh: 一个由环境和野生动物组织组成的联盟正在起诉特朗普政府，诉讼的部分矛头指向一项规定，该规定在确定濒危物种和关键栖息地的保护措施时，过度遵从“经济考量”。

paragraphs.en: “What we’re seeing is the result of several decades of sustained protection of these species under the ESA and various other measures to protect their habitat in different ways,” said David Godfrey, executive director of the Sea Turtle Conservancy, an advocacy group that is not a plaintiff in the lawsuit, but is supportive of it.
paragraphs.zh: “我们所看到的，是这些物种在《濒危物种法》和其他各种保护其栖息地措施下，数十年持续保护的结果。”海龟保护协会执行理事戴维·戈弗雷说。该倡导组织不是这起诉讼的原告，但支持这起诉讼。

paragraphs.en: “It takes just about any species of sea turtle 20, 30 years to reach maturity, to come back and nest, to return to beaches where they were first protected as eggs or as hatchlings and afforded the opportunity to live without ending up in a fisherman’s net and on a table in a nice restaurant.
paragraphs.zh: “几乎所有种类的海龟都需要二三十年才能成熟，才能回来筑巢，回到它们最初作为卵或幼体受到保护的海滩，得以活着长大，而不是最终落入渔民的渔网、摆上高档餐厅的餐桌。”
